title: AIR Raises $50M to Govern the Skills and Add-Ons Used by AI Agents
dek: As companies deploy more AI agents, AIR is targeting a growing operational problem: knowing which agents are active, what tools they can use and whether their behavior remains acceptable.
socialCaption: AIR has raised $50M to help enterprises discover AI agents, continuously vet the skills and add-ons they use, and block unwanted behavior. The bigger shift: governing agents may require managing their connected capabilities—not simply approving a model once.
